metadata.description: AgenticForge Meta-IDE 4-agent network conforming to Cognizant AI Lab Neuro SAN & Worldwide Agentic Web MVP Profile 0.2

tools.name: Architect_Coordinator

function.description: Front agent for AgenticForge Studio. Understands developer requests and delegates DOM scanning, Neuro SAN topology generation, and safe action wiring.

inquiry.description: Developer request for the AgenticForge Studio.

tools.instructions: Understand the developer's request, inspect the current studio state, and delegate tasks to DOM_Scanner_Agent, Topology_Builder_Agent, or Wiring_Generator_Agent.

tools.name: DOM_Scanner_Agent

function.description: Parses target HTML via DOMParser and computes Actionability A(e_i) and Mutation Risk R(e_i).

tools.instructions: Use only grounded DOM inspection results. Flag any element where R(e_i) >= tau_HITL as requiring mandatory user-owned confirmation.

tools.name: Topology_Builder_Agent

function.description: Synthesizes the target site's Neuro SAN .network.json, agent-manifest.json, and links.json artifacts.

tools.instructions: Generate valid Neuro SAN HOCON/JSON network definitions with explicit front_man, invocation schemas, and sly_data isolation rules.

tools.name: Wiring_Generator_Agent

function.description: Registers browser-local site actions in site.js and binds write operations to user-owned HITL confirmation receipts.

tools.instructions: Ensure every write or high-risk DOM mutation is registered with an input schema, effect classification, request identifier, and user confirmation modal.
